meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: Privacy policy of the Lychen association: data controller, data collected, cookies, retention periods and how to exercise your rights under the GDPR.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
The Lychen association is committed to respecting your privacy and protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains, in a clear and transparent manner, how your data is collected and processed when you browse this website.
This is an informational website (showcase site). It does not offer account creation or online sales. This document is established in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of 27 April 2016 (GDPR) and French Law No. 78-17 of 6 January 1978 on data processing, data files and individual liberties.

sections.title: Site publisher and data controller
sections.content:
This website is published by the Lychen association, a non-profit association governed by the French law of 1 July 1901.
Registered office: 1 allée du Trélod, 74000 Annecy, France
SIREN: 993 140 904 — SIRET: 993 140 904 00018
Publication director: the association's presidency
The controller of personal data is the Lychen association, represented by its presidency.
Contact: contact@lychen.org

sections.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
sections.content:
For any question regarding the processing of your personal data or the exercise of your rights, you can contact our Data Protection Officer:
By email: dpo@lychen.org
By post: Association Lychen — DPO, 1 allée du Trélod, 74000 Annecy, France

sections.title: Data collected
sections.content:
This website is static and informational. No user account is required and no personal data is collected through forms on this site (unless otherwise explicitly stated at the point of collection).
While you browse, technical connection data (IP address, date and time of the request, browser type, pages visited) may be automatically recorded in the hosting provider's logs, for security and proper-operation purposes.
If you contact us directly by email, we process the data you provide on your own initiative (email address, message content) in order to respond to your request.

sections.title: Purposes of processing
Legal basis for processing
Cookies and trackers
sections.content:
This website does not use any advertising tracking cookies or audience-measurement tools that require your consent.
Only cookies and technical storage strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the site may be used; these are exempt from consent in accordance with the recommendations of the CNIL (the French data protection authority). Your display preferences (language, light or dark theme) are stored locally on your device and are never transmitted to third parties.
You can configure your browser at any time to block or delete these items.

sections.title: Recipients of the data
sections.content:
Your data is never sold, rented or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
It is accessible only to authorised members of the association who need to know it, as well as to our hosting provider acting as a processor, solely for the technical operation and security of the site.

sections.title: Hosting and transfers outside the EU
sections.content: The technical data related to the site is hosted within the European Union. No transfer of personal data outside the European Union is carried out in the course of operating this website.

sections.title: Retention period
Data security
sections.content: The association implements appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorised access. Exchanges with the site are encrypted using the HTTPS (TLS) protocol, and access to data is restricted to authorised persons only.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content:
In accordance with the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, you have the following rights over your data: the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, as well as the right to object to processing and the right to set guidelines regarding the fate of your data after your death.
To exercise these rights, send your request to our DPO at: dpo@lychen.org. Proof of identity may be requested. We undertake to respond within one month of receiving your request.

sections.title: Right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL
sections.content:
If, after contacting us, you believe that your rights are not respected, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (CNIL):
CNIL — 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, France
Website: www.cnil.fr

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.content: This privacy policy may change in order to reflect legal, regulatory or technical developments. The date of the last update appears at the top of the page. We encourage you to review it regularly.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For any question regarding this privacy policy or the processing of your personal data, you can write to us at: contact@lychen.org (or dpo@lychen.org for requests relating to data protection).
